name: What happens after I reach out about a remodeling project?

mainEntity.name: What happens after I reach out about a remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process usually starts with a site visit, measurements, and a conversation about what you want changed and what needs to be repaired. After that, HH Remodeling can define the scope, identify any hidden issues, and build a plan that covers materials, schedule, and construction steps.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect a site visit, measurements, and a scope review first. Then HH Remodeling can map out the work, materials, and next steps before construction begins.
